headline: Acquired brands drive revenue, core brand keeps shrinking
summary_short: Celsius Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $817.9 million, up 10.6% y/y on the Alani Nu and Rockstar Energy acquisitions, while diluted EPS fell 57.6% y/y to $0.14 on an $80.9 million distributor termination fee and gross margin compression to 48.1% (-340bps y/y).
summary_long: Revenue growth came entirely from acquired brands: Alani Nu contributed ~$364.4M and Rockstar Energy ~$66.5M, while core CELSIUS revenue fell 11.7% y/y on trade spend, SKU optimization, and club-channel softness. Gross margin fell 340bps y/y to 48.1% on promotional activity and mix, partly offset by integration synergies; management said margin held flat versus Q1. Operating and net income fell sharply y/y, mainly on an $80.9M distributor termination fee (none in Q2 2025). The company repurchased ~$100.4M of shares. No numeric forward guidance was given; management reiterated qualitative margin-expansion initiatives offset by rising commodity costs.
